purpose: MOSRA SimMode 2: the aged operating point of an NMOS held at a fixed drain current shifts its gate by the aged delvto.

oracle.command: Xyce fresh.cir  (this deck without the mosra cards, level=49 -> level=9, .op, .print dc v(g))
oracle.derivation: Fresh v(g): the deck's circuit without MOSRA, BSIM3 (HSPICE level 49 is BSIM3v3) in Xyce 7.10.0 (level 9): 0.390865613 V, i(vd) = -9.99960913e-06 A. Aged v(g): BTI only, titfd = tittd = 0, so dVth = tit0*t^tn = 1e-4*(1e8)^0.25 = 0.01 V; with Vds, Vbs and Ids pinned by the servo, Vgs - Vth is unchanged and v(g) aged = v(g) fresh + 0.01 V.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b fresh.sp  (level=8 version=3.3; aged: the same with delvto=0.01)
confirmed.note: fresh 0.3908655379 V, aged (delvto=0.01) 0.4008654972 V: the aged gate moves 0.0099999594 V. ngspice cannot run MOSRA, so this deck does not test it.
